verdict.rationale: No evidence shows Cline's agent can be pointed at llms.txt or similar agent-oriented documentation files as a context source; the only llms.txt evidence found is Cline's own docs site exposing an llms.txt file about itself (cline-probe-1, cline-probe-2), which is about Cline publishing docs, not about consuming external llms.txt as a user-directed capability. General web-browsing (cline-docs-1) and MCP tool integration (cline-docs-16) are mentioned but never tied to llms.txt-style doc ingestion.
